name: Grazing table
colors: Linen with food in many colors
placement: Against a wall or open on both sides at 8 ft for 40 to 60 guests; keep both ends open so lines do not stack, and in shade outdoors.
modeling: A long table box 2.44 x 0.76 m at 0.76 m with a linen skirt, a runner box on top and rows of small boxes and low cylinders in varied colors (cheese, fruit, bread) of 0.03 to 0.12 m, with a few taller risers at the back.
